title: Herdr Worktree Configuration
description: Global and repository-specific settings used by hwt.

agent.description: Command an agent orchestrator should start in the new worktree.

worktree_dir.description: Directory for worktrees. Relative paths resolve from the repository root.

worktree_naming.description: Strategy used to derive the worktree directory name from its branch.

worktree_prefix.description: Prefix added to generated worktree directory names.

files.description: File operations performed after creating a worktree.

copy.description: Repository-relative files or directories copied into new worktrees. Missing sources are ignored. Use <global> in a project config to include global entries.

post_create.description: Shell commands run in order from the new worktree root. Use <global> in a project config to include global commands.
